scope.formula: For each workload/worker cell, B=(baseline-a median + baseline-b median)/2, C=(candidate-a median + candidate-b median)/2; ratio=C/B. Wall/driver/grounding use report medians; RSS uses each report median of child peak RSS over its two separate memory rounds. Aggregates are ratios of sums, not geometric means unless labeled.
scope.reference_scope: Clingo qualification compares complete selected displays, multiplicities, final optimal ties and costs. Full native typed atoms, shown values, costs and multiplicities independently match across every worker/report qualification; clingo hidden interpretations are unavailable.
scope.profiles: CPU/auto oracle/auto grounding/indexed formula joins/regions; completion_workers=1, batch_size=64; existing defaults; no resource override
scope.rss_scope: Separate fresh helper RUSAGE_CHILDREN, excluding helper; can include usage propagated by waited descendants. Not simultaneous process-tree RSS or device memory.
scope.wall_scope: Fresh process spawn/capture/reap includes native JSON/stats; comparison hashing excluded; no cold-cache claim
scope.statistics_note: Descriptive paired measurements, no significance test or causal attribution to one implementation change.
